dedupe_keys.name: roadworks endpoints of the states and territories with the vicroads data exchange

description: Roadworks endpoints of the states and territories, with the VicRoads Data Exchange is a group of 9 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by DataTfNSW; Department of Transport, WA; Road Report NT. Members: Roadworks endpoint ACT; Roadworks endpoint NSW; Roadworks endpoint NT; Roadworks endpoint QLD; Roadworks endpoint SA; Roadworks endpoint Tas; Roadworks endpoint VIC; Roadworks endpoint WA; and 1 more. Example entry: This data set is a record of planned road closures within the ACT based on the submission of Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) plans. This data contains all information recorded since the implementation of an ESRI Survey 123 solution to handle TTM Applications. Coverage is Australia and its states and territories; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as continuous (live), the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-11-03. Files and pages listed: API, GeoJSON, HTML, JSON (9 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY-4.0; other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
